comparator.route: Broad psychology route combining Cognitive Neuroscience and Social Psychology in Organisations
comparator.sourceNotes: The current 2026–2027 prospectus and current programme structure establish a broad three-year Psychology bachelor covering the major subdisciplines, methods and statistics, professional skills, specialisation choice, electives and a 15-EC bachelor project. The adopted 2025–2026 OER supplies the component-level credit structure that the current pages continue to describe: 60 EC first year, 60 EC later compulsory work, at least 20 EC of specialisation courses, 10 EC of Psychology electives and 30 EC of free-choice space. This coherent broad pathway instantiates Cognitive Neuroscience and Social Psychology in Organisations as two contrasting specialisation courses rather than selecting a narrow single-domain profile; the Psychology-elective and free-choice spaces remain open.

comparatorRouteSelection.route: Broad psychology route combining Cognitive Neuroscience and Social Psychology in Organisations
comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The normalized target is the generic Psychology bachelor. The programme requires specialisation choices but is explicitly broad. Selecting one cognitive-neuroscience course and one social-organisational course preserves that cross-domain identity and avoids presenting a narrow clinical, cognitive or organisational profile as the whole programme. The choice is independent of UCR fit.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad closest match covers the programme-wide psychology and research core. Brain and cognition and social and organisational psychology are independently evidenced, coherent, mechanically feasible and substantively distinct additional routes. Clinical/mental-health and development/trauma directions were also assessed, but three UCR alternatives is the maximum.

notes.text: Leiden Psychology provides a structured disciplinary sequence with dedicated psychometrics, psychodiagnostics, professional skills, specialisation courses and a supervised 15-EC bachelor project. UCR can build substantial psychology, cognition and organisational programmes, but it does not reproduce the same specialist practical structure or professional-qualification pathway.
